components.purpose: Opening banner at the top of the homepage. One instance of this component delivers the entire request: it renders a single hero layout, but holds a list of 'Personalized Hero Items' (heading, description, CTAs, background) each tied to a Target Audience. Add two items — one linked to the Healthcare audience, one linked to the Retail audience — so healthcare visitors and retail visitors each see their own banner content/messaging while sharing identical layout/styling. No other component is needed to satisfy this specific request.
